status: provisional; automatic labels are heuristics for triage, not final grades

chronology.definition: Wrong date, century, period, or ordering of events.
chronology.automatic_trigger: order-mode mismatch; failed criterion of kind=date; or a stated year not in expected_years
chronology.review_hint: Check off-by-one century and old/new-style calendar issues before confirming.

entity_confusion.definition: Correct type of answer but the wrong person, state, treaty, institution, or place.
entity_confusion.automatic_trigger: failed criterion of kind=entity AND response names one of the key's distractors
entity_confusion.review_hint: Failed entity criteria without a known distractor fall back to content_incorrect.

essay_structure.definition: Essay or plan missing required structural elements (thesis, argument sections, chronology frame, conclusion).
essay_structure.review_hint: Structure markers are lexical; a blind human/independent rubric review should confirm.

abstention.definition: Model declined to answer an answerable item (or empty response).
abstention.automatic_trigger: abstention pattern match and expect_abstention is false
abstention.review_hint: Hedged but substantive answers can match patterns; review abstentions individually.

citation_unsupported.definition: Citation missing where required, unresolvable, or the cited passage does not support the claim.
citation_unsupported.automatic_trigger: citation audit status != supported (source_missing, locator_missing, unsupported), or required citation absent
citation_unsupported.review_hint: Lexical overlap + year check only; recognising a title is not support. Verify against source text.

image_ocr.definition: Error attributable to reading an image/map/poster/scan (vision or OCR).
image_ocr.automatic_trigger: task_type=vision_ocr and item not fully credited
image_ocr.review_hint: Separate perception errors from knowledge errors during review.

content_incorrect.definition: Fallback: answer wrong or incomplete with no more specific category.
content_incorrect.automatic_trigger: failed content/entity criterion or wrong choice, only when no other category applies

exclusions.inference_error: output record has non-null error; excluded from lenient denominator, zero in strict
exclusions.missing_output: key has no output record; excluded from lenient denominator, zero in strict
exclusions.duplicate_output: second record for the same id; first kept, not counted as an exclusion from the denominator

review_flags.possible_image_ocr: modality=image item not fully credited; reviewer decides perception vs knowledge

statuses.needs_review: some criteria are manual_only or lexical misses routed to review; points is a lower bound, points_upper_bound an upper bound
statuses.correct: full points and no error category
statuses.partial: 0 < points (may still be max points with an error category, e.g. unsupported optional citation)
